confidence_note: Research modes are not NKR incident rates. PDF qualification scenarios are proposed tests; engineering signatures are preventive patterns. None represent executed protection.

records.title: Task specification violation
records.remedy: Check changed paths and behaviors against the signed task scope; undo unrelated edits.
records.source_note: MAST publication; mitigation is NKR engineering proposal

records.title: Role specification violation
records.remedy: Compare tool invocation against the assigned role and resource allowlist; deny excess.
records.source_note: MAST publication; mitigation is NKR engineering proposal
